scenes.narration: I was recording a late night vlog at my desk. Dim lamp. Cold tea. A smart speaker on the shelf behind me.
I never talk to it. But it lit up. A soft blue ring. It said, in a flat polite voice, there is someone behind you.
I laughed. I said, stop it. The speaker said, do not turn around. I did not move. The camera was still recording.
I looked at the laptop screen instead. Behind my chair, in the reflection, the door was open. I always lock it.
The speaker said, it is waiting for you to look. I asked who it was. The speaker said, I cannot say. It is listening too.
Then the blue ring turned red. The speaker whispered, now. And behind me, the floor creaked. Once. Close.
I stared at the screen. In the reflection, a tall shape bent over my shoulder. And the speaker said, thank you for not looking.
So tell me. Do you turn around, or keep staring at the screen?
